messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-78200 triggered for tenant acme-north-america — symptom: increased 5xx for /v1/infer on dedicated routing pool. Detected 2026-03-15T02:13:09Z

Jordan (oncall-sre): I'm on it. Getting 502/503s from routing-proxy when forwarding to backend shards. Reproduced via curl against tenant endpoint. Switch to incident channel.

Alex P (eng): seeing connection reset errors in proxy logs. Snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:58Z routing-proxy ERROR ConnectionReset: handshake failed to node-gpu-12 tenant=acme-north-america
2026-03-15T02:13:02Z routing-proxy WARN pool_exhausted: active=10240 limit=10240 tenant=acme-north-america
```

Jordan (oncall-sre): pool_exhausted looks likely. Quick mitigation options: 1) enable cross-tenant shared-pool fallback for ACME, 2) flip to dev-fallback model variant, 3) temporarily increase per-tenant pool limit. Thinking (1) or (3) are fastest.

Samir (se-runtime): paging runtime on-call. We should prefer (3) + rolling restart of affected proxy worker to free stuck sockets. Cross-tenant fallback has compliance concerns for some enterprise accounts — need ACME approval.

Maya R (customer-success): ACME is enterprise; check contract before using shared pools. If we must, we'll escalate to their security/ops. For now, try (3) and keep them informed. I'll prepare a customer-facing statement.

Priya (support): drafting a short email we can send once mitigation in place. TEMPLATE:
Subject: [Redwood] Temporary inference availability issue — ACME dedicated routing (NA)
Body: "Hi Mark/Ana — we detected increased 5xx errors for requests to your dedicated inference routing starting at ~02:13 UTC. Engineers have applied a temporary configuration change so requests should be succeeding. You may see increased latency or a fallback model variant for a short time. No customer data was modified. We will follow up with an RCA and timeline. Bridge: <zoom link>. For urgent escalation call +1-800-REDBOX."

Laila (customer-success): add ACME POC list to the email (we have contacts): Mark R (mark.r@acme.com) +1-555-0102, Ana S (ana.s@acme.com) +1-555-0103. Also mention that we'll only route to compliant pools.

Jordan (oncall-sre): executing hotpatch to bump per-tenant pool limit from 1024 -> 4096 on routing-proxy for acme-north-america. Command:
```
redwoodctl proxy config set --tenant acme-north-america --key pool.max --value 4096 --reason "mitigation: pool_exhausted"
```
Executing now.

Incident Bot: :pager: SE-runtime paged for assistance on PD-78200.

Samir (se-runtime): joining. Also creating a Zoom bridge: https://zoom.internal/incidents/PD-78200

Alex P (eng): hotpatch applied to 3/5 proxy nodes; immediate drop in 5xx counts on those shards. Rolling to remaining nodes.

Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Hotpatch rolled to all affected proxy nodes at 02:21 UTC. 5xx rate decreased by ~92% on ACME traffic.

Jordan (oncall-sre): smoke tests show successful 200 responses now. Latency slightly elevated (~220ms) vs baseline 110ms. Keeping incident open to watch for regression and to perform controlled revert when stable.

Maya R (customer-success): Sent initial customer notification at 02:24 UTC (cc internal). Mark replied: "Thanks. ETA on full restore? Any risk to data?"

Jordan (oncall-sre): reply drafted: "No data was modified or lost. We applied a configuration increase and rolling restarts; primary routing is being validated. We'll provide ETA for full restoration in the next update (target +30m)."

Julian K (product): preparing status page entry. Short summary proposal:
"ACME dedicated routing in North America experienced elevated 5xx errors between 02:13 - mitigated at 02:21 UTC. A temporary configuration change has been applied. No data loss. Engineers are performing validation."

Priya (support): status page body drafted for /customers/acme:
Start: 2026-03-15T02:13 UTC
Impact: Increased 5xx (502/503) for inference requests on ACME dedicated routing in NA. Some requests may have been retried or routed to fallback models.
Mitigation: per-tenant connection pool limit increased and rolling restarts applied to routing-proxy nodes.
Current status: Mitigation in place; monitoring. Next update: in 30 minutes or on change.

Samir (se-runtime): we should capture action items for engineering: examine why per-tenant pool reached limit (socket leak? sudden connection storm?) and implement auto-scaling or graceful degradation instead of hard rejects.

Alex P (eng): logs show a spike of retries from ACME's traffic pattern after their ML client increased parallelism last week. The proxy's max per-tenant connections was fixed at 1024 for safety. Need autoscaling or backpressure from client SDK. I'll open a follow-up RFC.

Jordan (oncall-sre): setting severity to Sev2 (customer-impacting with mitigation). Assigning ENG-runtime and SE-runtime for RCA. Escalate to Eng manager if we see recurrence.

Incident Bot: :memo: PD-78200 incident channel created; PagerDuty will close after monitoring window.

Maya R (customer-success): follow-up note to ACME at 02:45 UTC: "Primary routing validated; traffic is returning to baseline. We will send a full RCA with timeline and remediation steps in the next 48 hours. If you'd like, we can set up a 30-min postmortem with your team." Mark responded: "Please schedule the postmortem. Also send details on what changed and any client-side mitigations."

Jordan (oncall-sre): monitoring window passed, no recurrence for 20m. Revert plan: revert increased pool limit to default and instead implement a controlled auto-scale in next deploy. Recommend leaving current config until change is shipped to avoid flapping.

Julian K (product): agreed to leave config until an autoscale patch is ready. Product will work with Eng on rollout plan.

Priya (support): closing note in PD and scheduling status-page final update. Final status page update: "Resolved: Mitigation applied and validated; root cause under investigation; RCA forthcoming."

Maya R (customer-success): created post-incident customer RCA draft assigned to Alex (eng) for technical writeup and to Samir (se-runtime) for infra items. Timeline to ACME: 48 hours for draft, 1 week for mitigation plan.

Alex P (eng): opening internal RCA ticket PD-78200-RCA and draft link: https://internal-docs/rcas/PD-78200 (will populate with logs, timeline, and remediation steps).

Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Incident PD-78200 marked RESOLVED at 02:53 UTC following monitoring period. Thread archived at 03:15 UTC.
